chapter.verse: “A hang pen vantung kumpigam i cih ciangin a lenggah lo' ading nasem a cial dingin zingsang tuungin a pusuak inntekpa tawh kibang hi.
Amah in nitha ngeina denarius tang khat piak dingin nasemte tawh a kithukim khit ciangin amaute a lo ah kuansak hi.
Zingsang nai kua pawlin a pusuahkik leh sumbuktual ah awngkhongin a ding mi kimkhat a muh ciangin
tua mite' kiangah, ‘No zong lenggah lo ah va kuan un. A kilawmzah khat kong pia ding hi,’ ci hi.
Amau zong kuan uh hi. Sunkim nai sawmlenih leh sunnung nai thum pawlin pusuak kik a, tua bang mahin hih hi.
Nikai nai nga pawlin zong pusuak a, a ding dangte a muh ciangin tua mite' kiangah, ‘Bang hangin hih lai-ah sun thapai awngkhongin ding na hi uh hiam?’ ci-in dong hi.
Tua mite in, ‘Kuamah in ko hong cial lo hi,’ a cih uh ciangin amah in, ‘No zong lenggah lo ah va kuan un,’ ci hi.
“Nitak hong tung a, loneipu in a nasem ukpa' kiangah, ‘Nasemte sam inla a kuan nunungpente pan panin a kuan masapente dong a thaman uh pia in,’ ci hi.
Nai sawmlekhatna pawl-a kicialte hong pai ciangin denarius tang khat ciat ngah uh hi.
A kicial masate hong pai uh ciangin tam a ngahzaw ding kisa uh a, ahih hangin amau zong denarius tang khat ciat mah ngah uh hi.
Tua mite in sum a san kawmun inntekpa phunsan uh a,
‘Hih a kuan nunungpente in nai khat sung bek sem uh hinapi, ko sun thapai nisa thuakin na a semte tawh nong kikimsak hi,’ ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin inntekpa in tua mite khat' kiangah, ‘Lawm aw, nang' tungah kong semkhial kei hi. Nitha denarius tang khat ding mahin a thukimsa hilo na hi hiam?
Nang' a nang'n la inla ciah in. A kuan nunungpenpa zong nang kong piak tawh a kibang ka pia nuam hi.
Keima' neihsa kei' deih bangin ka zattheih hilo ahi hiam? Hih banga ka cit pen hoh, haza na hi hiam?’ ci hi.
Tua ahih manin a nunungte masa ding a, a masate nunung ding hi.”
Jerusalem lam a paitoh ding ciangin Jesu in nungzui sawmlenihte tonpih a, lampai kawmin amaute' kiangah,
“En un, Jerusalem lam i paito ding hi. Siampi liante leh laisiamte' kiangah Mihing' Tapa kilehhek ding a, tua mite in sih thukhenna pia ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin zahpihna, nakpi satna leh singlamteh tunga khailupna a thuak dingin Gentile-te' kiangah ap ding uh hi. Ahih hangin a ni thum ni-in amah kithokiksak ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Zebedee' tate ii nu, a tate tawh hong pai-in Jesu' mai-ah khukdinin na khat ngen hi.
Jesu in, “Bang deih na hi hiam?” ci hi. Nupinu in, “Na kumpigam sungah hih ka tapate nih, na taklam ah khat, na veilam ah khat, a tu dingin thupia in,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Na nget uh bang hiam cih na thei kei uh hi. Kei' dawn hai a dawn dingin na hizo uh hiam?” a cih ciangin amau zong, “Ka hizo uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Keima' hai na dawn ding uh a, ahi zongin ka taklam leh ka veilam ah tutding pen kei' piaktheih hilo-in ka Pa' bawlkholhsak mite' ading ahi hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu, nungzui a dang sawmte in a zak uh ciangin unau nihte' tungah heh uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu in nungzuite a kiangah samin hih bangin ci hi: “Gentile uliante mipi' tungah kithuneisak uh ahihlam leh a miliante un uktheihna thu suang uh ahihlam na thei uh hi.
No teng kikal ah tua bang hilo ding hi. Note' lakah milian a suak nuam peuhpeuh nomau' nasem ahih kul a,
note' lakah a masa a ut peuhpeuh nomau' sila a suah kul hi.
Mihing' Tapa zong mi' don dingin hong pai hilo a, mi a don dingin leh ama' nuntakna mi tampi' ading tatman bangin a piakhia dingin hong pai hizaw hi.”
Jericho khua pan a paikhiat uh ciangin mihonpi in amah zui uh hi.
Tua ciangin, en un, lampi gei-ah khuamulo mi nih tu uh a, Jesu hong pai cih a zak uh ciangin, “Topa aw, David' Tapa aw, kote hong khual in!” ci-in kiko uh hi.
Mihonpi in tuate gel a daih nadingin a taai uh hangin amaute in, “Topa aw, David' Tapa aw, kote hong khual in!” ci-in a uangzaw-in awng uh hi.
Jesu zong khawlin tuate gel sam a, “Bang kong hihsak ding ut na hi uh hiam?” ci hi.
Amau zong, “Topa aw, ka mit uh hong kihongsak in,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in tuate gel hehpihhuai sa ahih manin a mit uh lawnsak hi. Tua phetin a nihun khuamuhna ngahkik pah uh a, Jesu zui uh hi.
